headline: Recommended approval, with conditions, of a new beer and wine package store license at 590 Main Street.
summary: A public hearing was held on a new beer and wine package store license for Supreme Food Marketplace at 590 Main Street. Four people spoke in favor and none spoke against. The vote was 5-0 to recommend approval with six conditions, including no on-site alcohol consumption.
decisions: Recommended approval, with six conditions, of a new beer and wine package store liquor license at 590 Main Street, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: APPROVE, WITH CONDITIONS ... IN FAVOR: five (5): Ms. Morin, Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. Milette and Ms. Ford ... RECOMMENDATION: APPROVE

decision_titles: Beer & Wine Liquor License (Package Store- New) at 590 Main Street
plain_text:
ROLL CALL:  
 
Present: five (5): Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. Milette, Ms. Morin and Ms. Ford  
Absent: two (2): Mr. Mineo, Mr. Cunningham  
 
PUBLIC HEARING:  
 
Liquor License:  
 
1. Beer & Wine Liquor License (Package Store- New)  
Location: 590 Main Street  
Petitioner: RZJ Corporation – d/b/a Supreme Food Marketplace  
 
SPEAKING IN FAVOR: FOUR (4) 
SPEAKING AGAINST: ZERO (0)  
 
MOTION: APPROVE, WITH CONDITIONS 
 
CONDITIONS:  
1. Hours of operation shall be as stated on the application.  
2. There shall be no on-site consumption of alcohol. 
3. The public sidewalk along Main Street and Gardner Street shall be maintained, 
including snow removal.  
4. Any and all signage shall be properly permitted.  
5. The unused pole sign shall be re-used or removed.  
6. There shall be no banners, streamers or pennants located on the exterior of the 
building.  
 
IN FAVOR: five (5): Ms. Morin, Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. Milette and Ms. Ford 
OPPOSED: zero (0)  
MEETING MINUTES SUMMARY  
Date:  October 7, 2026 
Time:   6:00PM  
Location:  36 Court Street, Room 220, City Hall
ABSTAINED:  N/A  
RECOMMENDATION: APPROVE  
 
ALL OTHER MATTERS PROP ERLY  BEFORE THE BOARD
